title: State Street Global Advisors - Senior Portfolio Management, ISG, VP

cond_0001.intro:
The Senior Portfolio Manager is a key role within [Company name masked]'s Investment Solutions Group (ISG) and will be focused on building and managing asset allocation investment strategies for the [Location masked] wealth management marketplace. In this capacity, the Senior Portfolio Manager plays an integral role for the team in terms of portfolio construction and design, delivering on performance objectives and interacting with clients and prospects. Additionally, the individual will actively participate in the team's ongoing research efforts, process improvement and product development - particularly for customized model portfolio opportunities.
The successful candidate will have hands on experience in portfolio management, a passion for the capital markets, and strong communication skills. Experience in the [Location masked] wealth market, tax efficient portfolios, income investing and/or model portfolios would be differentiators.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Multi-asset class portfolio management including setting strategic and tactical asset allocation policy, selection of best in class investment vehicles from an open-architecture line-up and allocating across both active and index investment strategies
Contributions to thought leadership efforts that highlight ISG's market insights and research relevant to the [Location masked] Wealth market
Client engagement both in maintaining and driving new business requiring excellent written and verbal communication skills and experience interacting with clients, prospects and gatekeepers in the model portfolio industry
Active participation in ongoing research efforts, process improvement, and product development
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10 Plus years of investment experience
BA/BS
Strong knowledge of portfolio construction, risk management, and quantitative investment methods
Well-developed presentation and business writing skills
Preferred Requirements
Advanced Degree / CFA / CAIA / CFP, or progress towards
Familiarity with optimization tools and financial software (e.g. FactSet, Bloomberg, Axioma, PORT)
Positive attitude, strong work ethic, ability to execute independently yet also maintain a strong team orientation, proactive thinker with a desire to continue to learn and grow professionally
